home.title: Beyond the postcard.
home.lead: Discover Italy. Study here. Live here. Make it yours.
home.heroAlt: A stone arch opening onto the sea and palm trees

home.ideaText: Aviora was founded by Aliya with a simple idea: make Italy easier to discover, understand and experience.
home.ideaMore: Moving to another country can feel overwhelming. Universities to compare, requirements to understand, documents to prepare, housing to find. Aviora brings the useful pieces together in one clear place.

admissions.intake: Most intakes start in September. Applications often open in autumn or winter of the year before.

study.mentorText: Student-to-student mentoring helps turn a general goal into clear next steps.

life.title: Small things, said slowly.
life.lead: These everyday moments matter as much as the famous landmarks.

moments.title: Coffee at the bar
moments.text: You order at the counter and drink it standing. Sitting at a table costs more, and nobody minds you leaving after two minutes. A cappuccino after lunch is not illegal, just a little unusual.

moments.title: Lunch closes things
moments.text: Many offices, small shops and pharmacies close in the early afternoon. Plan errands for the morning and you will spend less time in queues.

moments.title: The crowded train
moments.text: Regional trains fill up at rush hour. Validate a paper ticket before you board, or tap a contactless card where it is accepted.

moments.title: The market
moments.text: Neighbourhood markets sell fruit and vegetables for less than supermarkets. Go late and prices drop. Go often and people start to recognise you.

moments.title: The slow day
moments.text: Many shops close. Museums open. The first Sunday of the month, many state museums are free.

life.radioAlt: A vinyl record spinning on a turntable
life.radioText: Italian radio is a free language course. Put it on while you cook.

cities.title: Five cities, four lenses.
cities.lead: Some are built around universities. Some move faster. Some are quieter. Some feel international from the first day.

lensText.discover: Places, food, culture and things worth seeing.

cities.estimate: Approximate ranges for one student, 2026. Prices vary by neighbourhood and season.
cities.firstHereText: FIRST 30 shows what to do today, with the paperwork in the right order.
cities.bridge: Moving to Milan? Plan your first month.

practical.title: Practical Italy.
practical.lead: The paperwork and the plumbing, in plain language. The goal is simple: make complicated things easier to understand.
practical.officialText: Official information comes from the institution and links to it. From students is what people say it was like. We never mix the two.

documents.title: Documents
documents.when: you are preparing your application or visa.
documents.text: Passport, diploma, transcripts, translations and declarations of value. Keep digital copies of everything, and five paper copies of your passport.

housing.title: Housing
housing.when: you are looking for a room or about to sign.
housing.text: Start early, never pay a deposit without a contract, and make sure the lease is registered. A registered lease is your proof of address.

transport.title: Transport
transport.when: you need to get around the city or the country.
transport.text: City passes are cheaper under 26 or 27. Regional trains are cheap, high-speed trains are cheaper when booked early.

banking.title: Banking
banking.when: you need to pay rent or receive a scholarship.
banking.text: You need a codice fiscale to open an Italian account. Online banks are faster to open; local banks are sometimes required for scholarships.

healthcare.title: Healthcare
healthcare.when: you need insurance or a doctor.
healthcare.text: Non-EU students need valid insurance for the permit. Registering with the national service gives access to a family doctor.

university.title: University procedures
university.when: you are enrolling or need your student card.
university.text: Enrolment, student ID, exam registration and the international office. Welcome weeks fix most problems in person.

expenses.title: Everyday expenses
expenses.when: you are planning a monthly budget.
expenses.text: Rent is the biggest line. Groceries, transport and a phone plan come next. Coffee is cheap if you stand.

services.title: Local services
services.when: you need a post office, a pharmacy or a copy shop.
services.text: Post offices handle permits. Pharmacies have a green cross. Tabaccherie sell stamps, tickets and the marca da bollo.

mentorship.title: Your path to studying in Italy, made clearer.
mentorship.lead: Personal guidance for students who want to study, apply and prepare for life in Italy.
mentorship.meetTitle: Founder of Aviora & Italy Admissions / Relocation Mentor
meetText: Aviora started from a simple observation: there is a lot of information about studying and moving to Italy, but it is scattered across universities, websites, forums and different sources.

Based on what students said, Aviora built a first practical version of the project and tested it with students from the Aviora media community. That became Aviora Student — student-to-student mentoring: practical experience, direct communication and personalised guidance.
The goal is not to do everything for a student, but to help create a clear system, from the first idea of studying in Italy to applications and relocation.
mentorship.researchLabel: students took part in Aviora’s research
mentorship.researchFinding: The recurring gap: students navigate university choice, admissions, documents, language, budgeting and relocation on their own, without one system connecting the steps.
mentorship.mvpText: tested with students from the Aviora community
mentorship.approachText: The goal is not simply to help someone get admitted. Aviora provides structure and guidance while keeping the decisions in the student’s hands.
mentorship.disclaimer: Aviora Mentorship provides educational and organisational mentoring based on personal experience and research. It does not provide legal, immigration or visa advice and does not represent universities. Official requirements should always be checked with current official sources.
mentorship.ctaText: Tell Aliya about your situation and your plans for Italy.
mentorship.ctaNote: No forms. No personal data collected on this site.

team.title: The people of Aviora.
team.lead: A small, dedicated team united by one idea: making the path to Italy clearer, more accessible and more human for international students.
team.behindTitle: And the team behind the team
team.behindText: The founding team is supported by developers, creatives and contributors who build Aviora behind the scenes. From technology and design to content, every contributor shapes the experience of the community. Aviora is growing, and its team grows with it.
team.closingText: From research and content to mentorship and community building, every part of Aviora is created with students and their real experiences in mind.

legal.title: Legal
legal.adviceText: Aviora shares educational information and personal experience. It is not legal, immigration or visa advice and does not represent any university or public office. Always check official sources before you act.
legal.storeText: Nothing on a server. FIRST 30 saves your arrival date and progress in your own browser (localStorage, key “aviora.first30”). Clearing your browser data removes it. You can also reset a city from the dashboard.
legal.cookiesText: None. The theme choice is saved in localStorage as “aviora.theme”.
legal.mapText: The FIRST 30 map loads OpenStreetMap only when you open it. OpenStreetMap receives the request like any website you visit.
